links.outcome: Comparison of GPT-4 versus GPT-3.5 (and prehospital scales) on stroke and LVO screening on same records
links.effect: GPT-4 outperformed GPT-3.5 in AIS (AUC 0.75 vs 0.59, P=0.015) and LVO (AUC 0.71 vs 0.60, P<0.001); results comparable to prehospital scales.
links.quote: GPT-4 outperformed GPT-3.5 in AIS screening (AUC 0.75 (0.65-0.84) vs 0.59 (0.50-0.69), P = 0.015) and LVO identification (AUC 0.71 (0.65-0.77) vs 0.60 (0.53-0.66), P < 0.001).

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the standalone diagnostic accuracy and reasoning capability of GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 on EMR records for prehospital stroke screening without testing an operational deployment practice or guardrail.
